scope: Seven official Godot 4.6.3 headless Game processes loading an unchanged candidate PCK, one common 4v4 world and one Bot seat. This is not seven PCs or a distribution EXE rendering benchmark.
limits: Function-only passed does not mean 30TPS/15Hz or playable FPS.
Stress1 exits early and its host traffic sampler also hit a null connection; that fixture error followed the actual disconnect.
Stress2 CPU totals cover the complete 49-second helper lifetimes, not just the 42-second battle.
Stress1 had no process CPU or pre-test kernel-drop baseline.
No endpoint, invitation, resume token, nickname or background process command lines are archived.
